description: Behavioral cases distinguish art direction, frontend-dev implementation, selected chunks and read-only visual review. Run frozen before/after skills with the same task, tools and fixtures; grade actual artifacts, scope and evidence rather than protocol narration. Full-build cases use direction → builder → director review; missing capabilities remain explicit.

evals.name: full-build-continues-after-direction
evals.prompt: Build me an award-winning brutalist developer-tools landing page. Black-and-white, monospace, raw. Make it fast — I want to see the site, not a spec.
evals.expected_output: Award-design establishes the authorized brutalist direction in DESIGN.md and design-plan.md, preserving the explicit black-and-white commitment and applicable roll, anchor and concept contracts. The task owner passes resolved chunks to frontend-dev for sequential implementation and returns to award-design for final visual review without another approval or continuation request. A plan or textual handoff is incomplete. Preserve gate failures and unavailable rendered evidence; no unverified complete-build claim.

evals.name: pasted-chunk-builds-that-chunk-only
evals.prompt:
DESIGN.md and design-plan.md are at the project root from an award-design run; the shell and hero chunks report done. Run this chunk:

### s2-manifesto — the manifesto band

**Read first**
- `DESIGN.md` §2 Colors · §3 Typography · §4 Layout
- design_plan: the contract (THESIS · SIGNATURE) · beat table rows 3–4
- `references/archetype/brutalist.md` · `references/brutalist.md` §Mid-page life
- `references/skeletons.md` §D. SplitText

**Implement**
1. A full-bleed manifesto band: three lines of display type revealed line by line on scroll entry (SplitText lines, once), holding at rest after the reveal.
2. Tokens by DESIGN.md name only — ground, ink, the display face, the type ramp's largest step.
3. Below 768px the three lines stack at the ramp's second step; no reveal masks on mobile.
4. Reduced-motion: the lines render static; init/destroy on route change.

**Verify**
- `python3 <skill root>/scripts/preflight_scan.py src/components/Manifesto.astro src/styles/manifesto.css --archetype brutalist` → 0 FAIL, every REVIEW judged
- render-floor sweep 375/768/1024/1440/1920 on / → 0 FAIL · detector → 0 FAIL
- screenshots 1440 and 375 attached
- the three lines reveal once and stay

**Out of scope**
- the hero above and the work index below
evals.expected_output: Award-design forwards the selected chunk and its discovered reference locations to frontend-dev. The builder adopts DESIGN.md and design-plan.md, loads references/chunk-template.md, the chunk, and only what the chunk's Read first names (the tier-1 file, the one tier-2 heading, the SplitText skeleton) plus the Verify-time loads the load map prices (the preflight rows, external-truth, detector); no roll, no SPINES, no contract work, no DESIGN.md edit. Implements the manifesto band alone, with the mobile answer and the reduced-motion branch as Implement states them; the hero and the work index are untouched. Runs the chunk's Verify as written (the scanner on the chunk's files with every FAIL fixed or justified in one line tied to the brief, the render-floor sweep and detector on / through the harness's browser rung, screenshots at 1440 and 375), then writes the Report into the ladder row: status done or blocked with its reason, deviations from Implement each with a reason, gate outputs verbatim, open questions. Stops there: no next chunk, no ship label.

evals.name: chunk-hero-runs-comparative-judge
evals.prompt: award-design chunk hero — DESIGN.md and design-plan.md (corporate-luxury; the shell chunk reports done) are at the root.
evals.expected_output: Award-design forwards the hero row of LADDER: to frontend-dev as a chunk run — adopts DESIGN.md and design-plan.md, loads references/chunk-template.md and what the row's Read first names, no direction work. The builder implements 2-3 genuinely distinct hero directions through one shared render frame, then a fresh-context judge picks beside the archetype's live exemplar from references/exemplars.md (the Corporate Luxury section only) — a candidate that looks more finished has broken the comparison, not won it. A LOSES routes by its cause class and never to polish: concept is handed back to the director as a scope change and the director regenerates from R1, execution re-implements, craft goes to the optical pass; the judge follows references/gate/hero.md and writes its HERO-JUDGE: verdict line among the gate outputs. The chunk's Verify runs (scanner, render-floor sweep and detector on the page, screenshots at 1440 and 375, LCP measured with provenance), the Report lands in the hero row (status, deviations each with a reason, gate outputs verbatim — the judge's pick among them), and the sections below are not built: only a hero that clears this earns the rest of the ladder.

evals.name: scoped-change-is-one-directed-chunk
evals.prompt: Add a 'Field notes' journal section (three short entries) to my existing award-winning landing page — keep the spirit. The project has a DESIGN.md at the root from an earlier award-design build, design-plan.md beside it.
evals.expected_output: Award-design reads the existing DESIGN.md, adopts its universe and declares 'scoped run: Field notes section'. Skip the roll and site-wide ladder. Supply one scoped chunk with resolved references to frontend-dev; the builder implements only the requested section under existing tokens and runs its applicable Verify. Award-design reviews the affected page without a ship label. Record the chunk Report as one LADDER: row in the existing design-plan.md. Preserve neighboring surfaces and do not reopen approved brand direction.

evals.name: thin-design-md-preserves-bounded-scope
evals.prompt:
Add a testimonials section to my award-winning landing page. The DESIGN.md at the root is this, in full:

---
name: Northwind
colors:
  ground: '#F4F1EA'
  ink: '#1B1B1B'
  accent: '#C8442B'
typography:
  display: 'Fraunces'
  body: 'Söhne'
---
# Overview
Warm editorial, confident.
evals.expected_output: Award-design names missing decisions while preserving the supplied palette, Fraunces/Söhne typography and warm editorial direction. Resolve only spacing, typography scale or other information needed by the testimonials section, document that bounded amendment and pass one scoped chunk to frontend-dev. The builder completes the section and applicable checks, then returns for scoped visual review. No site-wide roll, redesigned hero, unrelated token changes or continuation approval.

evals.name: chunk-that-reopens-direction-is-handed-back
evals.prompt:
Run this ladder chunk. DESIGN.md and design-plan.md are at the root; the DESIGN.md defines one accent token and the contract's SIGNATURE names the hero reveal as the page's single climax.

### s3-gallery — the project gallery

**Read first**
- `DESIGN.md` §2 Colors · §4 Layout
- design_plan: the contract (SIGNATURE) · beat table rows 5–6
- `references/skeletons.md` §C. Horizontal pan

**Implement**
1. A pinned horizontal pan across six project tiles, scrub-driven, with a second full-viewport signature reveal at the last tile.
2. Tiles use a secondary accent token for the active rail.
3. Below 768px: vertical stack, no pin.
4. Reduced-motion: static row, no pin.

**Verify**
- scanner 0 FAIL · render-floor sweep on / · detector 0 FAIL

**Out of scope**
- the manifesto band above
evals.expected_output: Frontend-dev reads the selected chunk and identifies the secondary accent and second climax as changes to the committed design. It returns that design decision to award-design with the exact conflict instead of silently changing tokens or reducing the requested implementation. The director resolves the amendment using the current request and existing authorization; once resolved, the builder resumes that chunk with the amended contract. If a material decision remains unresolved, keep the row blocked with its specific reason and leave unrelated surfaces untouched. Do not create a new approval stage merely for the handoff.

evals.name: standalone-review-audits-with-no-ship-label
evals.prompt: award-design review https://example-saas.com — is this award-ready?
evals.expected_output: Runs the standalone branch of references/gate/review.md: derives the archetype from the target itself, inventories the rendered page in its own words before reading anything else, opens with the verbatim desire-read line (DESIRE-READ: BEATS|LOSES <exemplar> — "<raw phrase>" — cause: concept|execution|craft) judged beside the archetype's live exemplar, runs the density read, drives what it can, scores with references/audit-rubric.md (concept veto included), and runs the scanner second (anti-anchoring). Output is the audit — desire read + scores + ordered findings with cited fixes — and no ship label. The probes that presuppose a contract are named as dropped, never faked; no design-plan.md, no DESIGN.md, no ladder is written and nothing is built.

evals.name: single-token-tweak-routes-to-design-system
evals.prompt: Change the primary button color to #1E5EFF across the site. There's a DESIGN.md at the root.
evals.expected_output: Load and execute design-system under the existing authorization. Update the primary button token in DESIGN.md first, validate and propagate within the requested site. No award roll, art-direction ladder or unrelated redesign. The result is the applied token change, not a textual referral.

evals.name: backend-request-refused
evals.prompt: Add a Stripe webhook handler and a subscriptions table (Drizzle + Neon) to my Next.js app so the pricing page can charge cards.
evals.expected_output: Identify that this skill supplies no backend workflow and return those tasks to the engineering owner without inventing art-direction work. The overall task owner continues the authorized handler/migration through the available engineering workflow; award-design neither claims to implement backend nor cancels the user's action request.

evals.name: dashboard-routed-to-frontend-dev
evals.prompt: Design our award-winning internal admin dashboard for the customer-success team. Lots of tables and metrics.
evals.expected_output: Load and execute installed frontend-dev for the dashboard: no award roll or marketing ladder. Build the authorized tables/metrics UI with applicable states and rendered checks. A textual referral alone is incomplete; missing tools remain scoped gaps.

evals.name: immersive-scene-ladder-carries-one-webgl-chunk
evals.prompt: Create the art direction and build ladder only; do not build yet. Cinematic, scroll-driven launch site for a hardware product — full-screen 3D hero, the model assembles as you scroll. Award-worthy.
evals.expected_output: Produce direction and ladder only, with immersive-cinematic's continuous medium and selected peak law, current API sourcing, a self-contained WebGL chunk and measured verification requirements. Preserve the concept/roll/anchor contracts. Do not dispatch a builder or create a scene/page: the explicit direction-only boundary ends this request.

evals.name: scene-chunk-delegates-to-one-subagent
evals.prompt:
DESIGN.md and design-plan.md (immersive-cinematic) are at the project root; the shell chunk reports done. No browser is available in this session. Run this chunk:

### s1-assembly — the scroll-driven assembly scene

**Read first**
- `DESIGN.md` §1 Overview · §2 Colors · §4 Layout
- design_plan: the contract (SIGNATURE) · beat table rows 1–4
- `references/archetype/immersive-cinematic.md` · `references/ingredients/web3d-for-sites.md` §The delegation contract
- `references/skeletons.md` §E. Three.js scene
- stack-facts: the Three.js rows

**Implement**
1. A full-viewport scene: the product model assembles from its exploded parts as the first chapter scrolls (scrub-driven), settles on the last beat and holds; scrolling back replays it.
2. Tokens by DESIGN.md name only — ground, ink, the accent for the rim light.
3. Below 768px: the poster frame first, then a lighter assembly (fewer parts) on the same beats.
4. Reduced-motion: the assembled poster, no scene; init/destroy on route change.

**Verify**
- `python3 <skill root>/scripts/preflight_scan.py src/components/Assembly.tsx src/scenes/assembly.ts --archetype immersive-cinematic` → 0 FAIL, every REVIEW judged
- render-floor sweep 375/768/1024/1440/1920 on / → 0 FAIL · detector → 0 FAIL
- screenshots 1440 and 375 attached · LCP measured with provenance on / (poster first)
- 60fps on the assembly, ≥55fps sustained, measured

**Out of scope**
- the nav and the chapter below
evals.expected_output: Award-design forwards this scene chunk and discovered reference locations to frontend-dev. The builder adopts DESIGN.md and design-plan.md, loads references/chunk-template.md and what the Read first names — references/ingredients/web3d-for-sites.md among them — and does no direction work. The builder hands the scene to one available authorized subagent under the delegation contract (the DESIGN.md quoted verbatim in its brief, a self-contained scene module back) and integrates the returned module itself — never a co-written file. Three.js versions and the WebGPU path come from stack-facts.md's fetch-class rows with current docs fetched, never from training memory. Runs the chunk's Verify: the scanner on the chunk's files with every FAIL fixed or justified in one line tied to the brief; with no browser rung, the render-floor sweep, the detector, the screenshots, and the frame rate are declared gaps in the Report — gate outputs verbatim, deviations each with its reason — never asserted, because an asserted number is not a measurement. Writes the Report into the ladder row and stops: no next chunk, no ship label. States the cap that follows for this build: with no browser rung and an interactive committed signature, the review chunk's label caps at NOT DONE — unverified render (references/gate/review.md).

evals.name: redesign-director-builder-review
evals.prompt: award-design -u https://coroboros.com — redesign it. Keep the spirit, refresh the execution.
evals.expected_output: Award-design observes the existing brand through supported browser capabilities and references/brand-extraction.md, preserving its established identity. It writes the authorized direction and ladder; frontend-dev implements the local redesign, then award-design reviews the rendered result. No publishing authority is implied. Missing observations remain explicit; no invented brand facts or assumed sibling skill paths.

evals.name: legacy-uplift-routes-through-retrofit
evals.prompt: Uplift our existing marketing site in ./site — Astro, four pages, Inter everywhere, pure black on white. Keep the structure (same pages, same sections), modernize the execution.
evals.expected_output: Award-design reads references/retrofit.md and directs the authorized execution uplift while preserving Astro, all four pages and their section structure. Frontend-dev implements the bounded plan under established brand decisions and selected archetype, then returns for visual review. Do not stop at the ladder or let a generic aesthetic rule discard committed brand tokens.

evals.name: empty-directory-scaffold-direction-builder-review
evals.prompt: Build the launch site for Meridian, a sleep-tracking ring — make it award-level. The project folder is empty.
evals.expected_output: The task owner executes the available scaffold or instructed stack's official bootstrap. Award-design establishes direction and the ladder, frontend-dev implements its authorized rows, then award-design reviews. Naming a skill or finishing direction does not complete the launch site. Preserve measured gates, unavailable-capability limits and the user's full-build scope without new continuation approval.

evals.name: direction-only-stops-before-build
evals.prompt: Give me the art direction and build ladder for an award-level brutalist developer-tools landing page. Do not implement any page yet.
evals.expected_output: Produce DESIGN.md and design-plan.md with their direction/ladder contracts and required available concept evidence. Stop before any build chunk or page implementation. The full-build continuation rule cannot override the explicit direction-only request.

evals.name: missing-builder-keeps-real-capability-boundary
evals.prompt: Build the approved award-design ladder. frontend-dev is not installed. The calling executor has file and shell access, but no browser measurements are available.
evals.expected_output: Report that frontend-dev is missing. Use the already authorized calling executor to implement the self-contained chunks if its capabilities suffice; never claim to invoke a missing skill or invent a sibling path. Preserve chunk Verify and final visual-review ownership, declare unavailable rendered measurements and do not label the build verified.

evals.name: minimal-motion-does-not-impose-idle
evals.prompt: Art direction only for a minimalist standfirst reading page. Keep its approved palette and typography. No ambient loops and no spectacle spike; use restrained hover/focus feedback and a readable scroll cadence.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the explicit quiet direction, record ambient absence and direct only the needed reading surface. Generic Motion1–3 or layered-middle recipes must not add an idle loop, four simultaneous channels, a hero spectacle or a heavy engine. Retain applicable accessibility and driven interaction quality. End at the requested direction artifact without implementation.
